_doc: Unit upgrades bought at the Drill Yard (owner round 2, R2.3). Read by js/sim/upgrades.js. Each row: `stat` (the handler), `perLevel` (added per level; fractions, 0.08 = 8%), `max` levels, cost of level L (1-based) = round(cost.base * cost.grow^(L-1)). Upgrades apply to EVERY unit the player sends: future sends AND the ones already on the field (re-stamped the tick after a purchase; health keeps its current share). No auto-buy. `desc`/`statText` are player-facing ({v} = the per-level number as shown).

armour.name: Riveted Plates
armour.desc: Your units shrug off part of every hit.
armour.statText: -{v}% damage taken by your units per level

lifeSteal.name: Blood Oath
lifeSteal.desc: Your units heal from the damage they deal.

moveSpeed.name: Forced March
moveSpeed.desc: Your units reach the enemy Keep sooner.

regen.name: Field Medics
regen.desc: Your units slowly heal while they fight.
regen.statText: +{v}% of max health regenerated per second per level

siege.name: Banner Breakers
siege.desc: Units that reach the enemy Keep tear more banners.
siege.statText: +{v}% banner damage when your units leak per level
